title: History-gap scenarios supply expected transition scores as inputs
reasoning: For transition cases, the produced history is used only for its length. Every checkpoint receives successful correctness evidence, and expected_rework and expected_regression are passed directly into the score calculator. Consequently, the assertions cannot detect failure to reset or resume transition state across a missing checkpoint.
reproduction: Change a fixture's produced flags while preserving its length and expected component values; the transition calculation receives identical inputs.
recommendation: Exercise the transition-producing code with the actual produced/missing sequence and compare its resulting components against the golden expectations.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included lineage test covers consecutive produced checkpoints, and the finalization tests cover missing evidence, but this history-gap scenario never sends its gap pattern into production logic.
suggestedRegressionTest: Expand the existing history scenarios to cover edits before and after missing checkpoints, verifying both reset behavior and subsequent repeated-edit tracking.
minimumFixScope: The history-gap golden test and its scenario setup.
